info.title: Clean Architecture API
info.description: HTTP endpoints for the Clean Architecture sample application.

get.description: Returns the available hospitals that patients can book into.
Returns all users assigned to the Doctor role so patients can book appointments.

post.description: Creates a new contributor with the provided name. The contributor name must be between 2 and 100 characters long.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all contributors. Supports GitHub-style pagination with 1-based page indexing and configurable page size.

200.description: Paginated list of contributors returned successfully

delete.description: Deletes an existing contributor by ID. This action cannot be undone.

get.description: Retrieves a specific contributor by their unique identifier. Returns detailed contributor information including ID and name.

404.description: Contributor with specified ID not found

put.description: Updates an existing contributor's information. The contributor name must be between 2 and 100 characters long.

400.description: Invalid input data or business rule violation

404.description: Contributor with specified ID not found

post.description: Allows admin to reset a user's password.
Authenticates user using Google ID token.
Sends password reset email to the user.

400.description: Failed to process password reset request

get.description: Returns Google OAuth configuration for frontend authentication.

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns access and refresh tokens.
Logs out the current user and clears authentication cookies.
Refreshes access token using a valid refresh token.
Registers a new user and returns authentication tokens.
Sends a new email verification link to the user.
Resets user password using reset token.
Validates JWT token and returns token status.
Verifies user email using verification token.
Approves a pending appointment. Doctors can only approve appointments assigned to them.

403.description: You do not have permission to approve this appointment

post.description: Creates a pending appointment request without requiring a login.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of appointments for staff review.

post.description: Declines a pending appointment with an optional note.

403.description: You do not have permission to decline this appointment

ErrorResponse.description: the dto used to send an error response to the client

statusCode.description: the http status code sent to the client. default is 400.

message.description: the message for the error response

errors.description: the collection of errors for the current context

JWTBearerAuth.description: Enter a JWT token to authorize the requests...
